rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something jammed, a task that will not progress, or a program that has frozen.

example.english: I'm stuck on this report and don't know how to continue.
example.traditional: 呢份報告卡住咗，我唔知點樣繼續。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 kaa1 zyu6 zo2 ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 joeng2 gai3 zuk6

rows.note: Use this specifically when a person or object physically cannot move, rather than when a task or program has stopped progressing.

example.english: My foot is stuck in the door and can't move.
example.traditional: 我隻腳畀道門夾住，郁唔到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 bei2 dou6 mun4 gaap3 zyu6 juk1 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this for a frozen or hung program or device that is not responding.

example.english: My phone suddenly got stuck and nothing I press works.
example.traditional: 部電話突然冇反應，撳乜掣都冇用。
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 waa2 dat6 jin4 mou5 faan2 jing3 gam6 mat1 zai3 dou1 mou5 jung6
